one_line: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets, data center talks advance in Japan, and global workplace AI use rises.

themes.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers, escalating their ongoing legal dispute.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats

themes.title: Energy firms and telecoms plan new data centres
themes.text: Japan's JERA is in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near Tokyo, while Bharti Airtel plans three new facilities in Assam. Meanwhile, developers are proposing vertical data centers to address land constraints.

stories.headline: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
Developers propose vertical data centers as Kansas City blocks high-rise plan
Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: AI adoption impacts workforce and jobs
themes.text: A JP Morgan report estimates AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs over five years, and Swiggy's Instamart is laying off 340 employees amid increased AI adoption. At the same time, a European Central Bank survey found EU workplace AI use matches US levels.

stories.headline: AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan
Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift
European Central Bank survey shows EU workplace AI use matches US levels

themes.title: UK regulator issues guidance on personal AI agents
themes.text: The UK Competition and Markets Authority warned that businesses offering personal AI agents must ensure user control over data access. Meta subsequently updated its UK terms of service for its Muse agent to reflect consumer law.

stories.headline: UK regulator warns AI agents must provide user control as Meta Muse launches
Meta changes UK Muse terms of service to reflect consumer law
